landing.badge: Where Artists Get Paid & Fans Get Access
landing.heroSub2: puts 80% of every dollar back in your pocket—and gives fans backstage access no other platform can. Think of it as
landing.heroSub4: built so creators actually get rich and fans actually get close.
landing.applyArtist: I'm an Artist — Let Me In
landing.visionText1: Spotify pays $0.003 per stream. Labels take up to 80%. You do all the work and see almost nothing. Social Music Fi exists because we believe the money should follow the music — straight into
landing.visionText2: . And for fans? You're no longer just a listener — you become part of the
landing.featuresSub: Every feature is designed around one question: does this put more money in artists' pockets and give fans a closer experience?
landing.feat1Desc: On other platforms, you're lucky to see 20%. Here, 80 cents of every dollar goes directly to you. No label cuts, no hidden fees. Just your music, paying your bills.
landing.feat2Title: Sell Exclusive Access Only Your Biggest Fans Can Unlock
landing.feat2Desc: Drop secret albums, behind-the-scenes content, or early releases that only token holders can access. Your superfans pay a premium — and they love it because they feel like VIPs.
landing.feat3Title: Fill Your Shows & Blow Up Your Streams
landing.feat3Desc: Promote directly to fans who actually care about your genre, your vibe, your sound. No wasted ad spend. Every dollar targets the listeners most likely to hit play, follow, and buy tickets.
landing.feat4Desc: A community rating system means listeners never wade through garbage. If your track scores 6+ points, it gets featured. High quality = more plays = more money in your pocket.
landing.feat5Title: Level Up with Pro Guidance & Collabs
landing.feat5Desc: Get matched with producers, vocalists, and industry mentors. This isn't just a platform — it's a launchpad. The connections you make here become the collaborations that define your career.
landing.ecoText1: Every transaction is secured on Ethereum — transparent, permanent, and 100% yours. No platform can freeze your earnings or change the rules on you.
landing.ecoText2b: to tip your favorite artists, unlock exclusive drops, boost tracks you love, and access premium content — all without ever leaving the app.
landing.ecoText3: A native SMFI token is coming soon — early supporters will unlock staking rewards, governance power, and exclusive DeFi perks that grow your earnings while you sleep.
landing.planSub: We reward real actions that help artists grow: joining, inviting friends, sharing tracks to social networks, and upgrading to subscription tiers that unlock stronger member benefits.
landing.planJoinDesc: New users can unlock welcome incentives by creating an account, completing their profile, linking a wallet, and taking their first meaningful actions in the app.
landing.planReferDesc: Share your referral link. When a friend joins and completes their first qualified activity, both accounts can receive bonus points or token-based rewards.
landing.planShareDesc: Promote tracks on TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, or other social channels. Verified clicks, plays, and saves can feed back into artist growth rewards and campaign boosts.
landing.planMemberDesc: PRO and PREMIUM members can unlock higher reward caps, premium drops, priority support, and stronger earning multipliers for the actions they already take every day.
landing.planPolicyTitle: Built to reward real support, not spam.
landing.planPolicySub: This member policy keeps incentives valuable for artists, fans, and subscribers by tying rewards to verified actions and clear limits.
landing.planRule1: Welcome rewards activate after signup completion and basic profile setup.
landing.planRule2: Referral rewards release only after the invited user completes a verified first action.
landing.planRule3: Social-share incentives should be tied to tracked engagement such as valid clicks, plays, saves, or follows.
landing.planRule4: Subscription members receive higher caps, earlier access, and bonus earning multipliers compared with free users.
landing.planProDesc: Higher daily earning caps, faster promotion tools, and cleaner ad-free browsing.
landing.planPremiumDesc: Everything in PRO plus early-access drops, VIP perks, and top-tier support priority.
landing.roadmapSub: Every phase is designed to put more money and power into the hands of artists and fans.
landing.phase1Desc: Accounts, profile activation, welcome rewards, referrals, paid memberships, and creator-code access now drive the first layer of user growth and retention.
landing.phase2Desc: Music upload, virtual NFT minting, NFT brochures, and Top Artist competition flows are live. Global distribution remains earned through competition grants rather than paid tier alone.
landing.phase3Desc: Distribution bridges, premium launch support, and broader campaign tooling are roadmap items. Winning the competition stays the gateway to global release eligibility.
landing.phase4Title: Automated Revenue Sharing And Fan Dividends
landing.phase4Desc: Revenue dashboards exist today, but automated payout issuance, fan-dividend settlement, and end-to-end royalty operations remain a later execution stream.
landing.roadmapRuleBody: Premium strengthens growth tools and support, but it does not unlock global distribution on its own. Distribution and revenue-sharing music NFT rights remain tied to Top Artist competition wins.
landing.ctaSub: Thousands of artists are already earning more here than they ever did on traditional platforms. Fans are unlocking experiences they can't get anywhere else. The only question is: why aren't you here yet?

productOverview.title: What Is Live, What Is Next
productOverview.subtitle: This overview is the canonical product matrix for the current release. It separates live capabilities, migration-window behavior, roadmap promises, and the later Phase 4 payout stream.
productOverview.matrixBody: Use this screen to understand what members can do today, what still depends on Top Artist competition wins, and which revenue-sharing claims are still roadmap only.
productOverview.phasesSub: Each phase below reflects the intended product truth for the current release, not just marketing copy.
productOverview.phase1Desc: Accounts, profile activation, welcome rewards, referrals, paid memberships, and creator-code access are live now.
productOverview.phase2Desc: Music upload, virtual NFT minting, NFT brochures, and Top Artist competition flows are operational during the current migration window.
productOverview.phase3Desc: Distribution bridges, premium launch assistance, and broader release tooling remain planned rather than fully shipped.
productOverview.phase4Title: Automated Revenue Sharing And Fan Dividends
productOverview.phase4Desc: Revenue dashboards are live, but automated payout issuance and dividend settlement are still a later engineering stream.
productOverview.entitlementsSub: This matrix locks the release rules for tiers, competition, distribution, and revenue positioning.
productOverview.freeDesc: Listen, follow, trade marketplace NFTs, complete profile setup, and earn base incentives.
productOverview.proDesc: Upload music, mint virtual NFTs, create NFT brochures, and enter monthly competitions.
productOverview.premiumDesc: Everything in Pro plus higher daily earning caps, faster promotion tooling, and VIP support priority.
productOverview.competitionDesc: Competition remains the path to higher release privileges and should stay visible as the core artist progression loop.
productOverview.distributionDesc: Not unlocked by paid membership alone. Eligibility remains tied to Top Artist competition grants.
productOverview.musicNftsDesc: Reserved for Top Artist winning tracks rather than general paid tiers.
productOverview.dashboardDesc: Artist and fan dashboards are live for visibility into plays, holdings, and modeled earnings.
productOverview.automationDesc: Operational payout issuance and dividend settlement are not yet automated.
productOverview.dividendsDesc: Dividend logic should be treated as a scoped Phase 4 delivery, not as a completed live system.
productOverview.note1: Legacy CREATOR rows still map to Pro during the migration window, so compatibility remains intentional.
productOverview.note2: Creator code stays as the complimentary access system name across user and admin flows.
productOverview.note3: Premium expands growth tools and support quality, but it does not bypass competition-earned distribution rules.
productOverview.ctaBody: Use this screen and the public roadmap together: they explain what is already operational, what is still migrating, and what should remain clearly marked as planned.
productOverview.nowBody: Memberships, creator tools, competition, referrals, and dashboard visibility are available today.
productOverview.nextBody: Roadmap expansion, clearer release support messaging, and Phase 4 payout automation remain the next delivery streams.
